arguments_exacts.prompt: Create a polished editorial cover image for Memlia, landscape 16:9 aspect ratio. An isometric 3D diorama representing a new client dossier arriving and blank documents prepared before signing. Composition: one open document folder containing completely blank sheets, exactly three document trays neatly aligned, and a round seal resting beside the last tray. Distribute blank paperwork among the three trays. The seal is separate and resting, with no stamping action. No arrows and no sending action. Simple geometric shapes, matte materials, soft light from the upper left, short shadows, abundant breathing room and a calm, restrained editorial composition. Dominant cream background #fcfbf7; clearly visible green #27b657 and deep green #1c8a41 accents; small graphite #231f20 touches. Use this specified visual language for continuity with Memlia covers; no external reference images are supplied. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, logos, people, client data, interface, red alert, or suggestion of automatic sending. All paper must be completely blank. High-quality crisp rendering, a refined tactile 3D illustration, clean uncluttered background.
